Generate adversarial perturbations of the training data using FGSM (Fast Gradient Sign Method) or PGD (Projected Gradient Descent). B â Machine Unlearning

Select points to "forget" by enabling Brush Mode (checkbox in the left panel) and dragging a rectangle on the canvas. Then run one of two unlearning strategies:

  • Gradient-Ascent Forget â takes N ascent steps on the forget set (maximising loss) while taking descent steps on the retain set to preserve accuracy.
  • Retrain from Scratch â builds a fresh network and trains only on the retain set; gold-standard baseline.
No points selected.
Select a region and run an unlearning method.

Interpreting results

Good unlearning: forget-set accuracy drops (the model no longer correctly classifies erased points) while retain-set accuracy stays high. A retrain-from-scratch result is the theoretical ideal â gradient-ascent is faster but approximate.

C â Custom Dataset

Paste a CSV with one example per line: x,y,label where x, y are floats in roughly [â6, 6] and label is 1 or -1. A header row and lines starting with # are ignored. Label 0 is mapped to -1.

Tips

After loading, press Train in the left panel to fit the network on your custom data. You can then run adversarial attacks or select points to unlearn just as with the built-in datasets. Export saves the current training data (including any you generated) as a CSV file you can re-load later.
